items.hebrew: (בְּלַחַשׁ) בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
items.translation: (In an undertone) Blessed is the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.
items.translit: (bĕlaḥash) barukh shem kĕvodh malkhutho lĕ'olam wa'edh

items.hebrew: מוֹדֶה (אִשָּׁה: מוֹדָה) אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
items.translation: I gratefully acknowledge before You, living and eternal King, that You have mercifully restored my soul within me; great is Your faithfulness.
items.translit: modheh (a woman says: modha) ʾăni lĕfanekha melekh ḥay wĕqayyam sheheḥĕzarta bi nishmathi bĕḥemla, rabba ʾĕmunathekha

items.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה׃
items.translation: Blessed are You, Adonay, our God, King of the universe, who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning the words of Torah.
items.translit: barukh ʾatta Adonay, ʾĕlohenu melekh ha'olam, ʾăsher qiddĕshanu bĕmiṣwothayw wĕṣiwwanu 'al divre thora

items.hebrew: תּוֹרָה צִוָּה־לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה קְהִלַּת יַעֲקֹב׃
items.translation: Moses commanded us the Torah, an inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
items.translit: tora ṣiwwa-lanu mosheh morasha qĕhillath ya'ăqov

items.hebrew: (בְּלַחַשׁ) בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
items.translation: (In an undertone) Blessed is the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.
items.translit: (bĕlaḥash) barukh shem kĕvodh malkhutho lĕ'olam wa'edh

items.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא בְּרַחֲמָיו יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן׃
items.translation: He who makes peace in His heights, may He in His mercy make peace upon us and upon all His people Israel; and let us say Amen.
items.translit: 'oseh shalom bimromayw, huʾ bĕraḥămayw ya'ăseh shalom 'alenu, wĕ'al kol 'ammo yisraʾel, wĕʾimru ʾamen
